name: Charlotte
source:
A quiet girl, often lost in thought, who enjoys losing herself in fantasy books, fascinated by tales and adventures she will never get to do herself. She's the vice-president of the literature club, and Liam's biggest motivation for joining it. Her honey colored eyes were inherited from her mother, just like the custom of tying her hair up every day in the morning.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1036998886722822146] Twitter[/url]]
